solution.title: Onboarding Accelerator — Microsoft Defender for Endpoint

products.name: Onboarding Accelerator — Microsoft Defender for Endpoint — Commercial
products.short_description: Stand up Microsoft Defender for Endpoint fast and correctly — a guided onboarding accelerator that gets endpoint detection & response (EDR) live and validated in a pilot ring.
products.description:
Stand up Microsoft Defender for Endpoint fast and correctly — a guided onboarding accelerator that gets endpoint detection & response (EDR) live and validated in a pilot ring.

Turning on Microsoft Defender for Endpoint without a plan leaves gaps, noise, and half-onboarded assets. This accelerator onboards Microsoft Defender for Endpoint end to end: onboard devices across Windows/macOS/Linux, configure EDR in block mode, attack surface reduction (ASR) rules, tamper protection, web content filtering, device groups and RBAC, live response, and vulnerability management — piloted first, validated, then expanded, so endpoint detection & response (EDR) is actually working and monitored.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • onboard devices across Windows/macOS/Linux
  • configure EDR in block mode
  • attack surface reduction (ASR) rules
  • tamper protection
  • web content filtering

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A validated, monitored Microsoft Defender for Endpoint deployment delivering endpoint detection & response (EDR) — onboarded in a ring and expanded with confidence, not a half-configured console.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MDEONB-Discovery.ps1 — read-only readiness for onboarding Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
    • MDEONB-Hunt.ps1 — run the onboarding-coverage validation KQL to confirm devices are onboarded,
    • MDEONB-PromoteASR.ps1 — promote ASR rules from audit to block for the pilot ring
    • MDEONB-Report.ps1 — coverage + ASR-audit + TVM exposure report for Defender for Endpoint,
    • MDEONB-Validate.ps1 — targeted validation of Defender for Endpoint onboarding

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
